nodes.question: Which remote sensing indices were used in the study to analyze erosion trends?
nodes.answer: The remote sensing indices used were NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index), NDSI (Normalized Difference Soil Index), and TGSI ( Topsoil Grain Size Index).

nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What are some commonly used empirical models for assessing water erosion?
nodes.answer: The commonly used empirical models for assessing water erosion include VIKOR, SWAT, RUSLE, and MPSIAC4.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Water infrastructure|Remote sensing and monitoring technologies_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What advantages do remote sensing-based models offer for assessing water erosion?
nodes.answer: Remote sensing-based models offer the advantage of quickly and cost-effectively gathering the necessary spatial information over large scales and across time, especially in areas with difficult access.
